reviews.title: Very Good and Reliable Mouse for the Price
reviews.comment: Fantastic mouse.  Very comfortable and Responsive.  Easy to use.  Good price.  Lasts a long time.  Takes 2 AA batteries, which are easy to replace.  Very portable, as well.
reviews.author: AK

reviews.title: This is a GREAT Mouse!!!
reviews.comment: This is a great mouse !!! I purchased it almost 6 months ago and it is still working smoothly. I found that Logitech has great products that last. I like all 5 of the functions and use them all on a regular basis. This is perfect for right handed people as it has great gripping as well as fits nicely in my hand
reviews.author: Steve

reviews.title: 10/10 work mouse
reviews.comment: Lasts forever.  Been my work mouse for years.  Batteries last forever in it.  Cheap enough to keep a spare in my laptop bag for when I need to travel for work.  Not a gaming mouse, but a serviceable work mouse.  But not tiny like a "travel mouse" so it isn't uncomfortable to use.  A man can use one without his hand cramping up.
reviews.author: oconnorz

reviews.title: Have to use the USB Receiver on the Front of Your PC
reviews.comment: This is a great mouse as long as you plug the little USB receiver into the front of your pc and not the back. Plugged into a front port, and the thing just flew, smooth as silk. I moved the receiver to a port on the back, and it got choppy, would freeze, and was really slow.
reviews.author: The Ghost

reviews.title: Excellent mouse, good size, enough buttons
reviews.comment: Easy to setup. Fit hand well. Has enough buttons to do everything I want. Good price.
reviews.author: SMH
